exposure: Obstetric Safe Surgery Checklist for cesarean deliveries
Use of an Obstetric Safe Surgery Checklist for cesarean deliveries
outcome: Communication among the team during CD
Agreement in the documentation of the indication for the CD between different members of the team
cohort: 600 cesarean deliveries on 2 labor and delivery suites
finding: Implementation of a safe surgery checklist can improve communication at CDs, but care should be taken when implementing checklists because they can have unanticipated consequences.
mod_finding: The study focused on the impact of a safe surgery checklist on communication during cesarean deliveries and did not directly investigate a specific mode of delivery.
